name: 86 Chaos 18.0.4
label: 86 Chaos 18.0.4
releaseTitle: Native System Bar and Launcher Branding Repair
notes: Mobile branch only; targeted mobile tests only.
Android content is inset away from status, navigation, and display-cutout system UI.
iPhone/iPad native runtime receives safe-area fallback styling from the shared web layer.
Android launcher icon now uses the existing 86 Chaos v4 safe-canvas asset.
No new paid service or Firebase project is introduced.
title: 86 Chaos 18.0.4
summary: Keeps the installed app clear of Android system bars and replaces the generic Android launcher icon with 86 Chaos branding.
description: Adds native Android window-inset handling, iPhone/iPad safe-area fallback styling, branded Android launcher assets, and explicit targeted regression coverage.
highlights: Packaged native app no longer sends /api requests to the phone-local asset server.
CapacitorHttp carries authenticated API calls to https://testing.86chaos.com while Firebase stays on the testing project.
Android and iOS native versions are aligned to 18.0.1 / build 180001.
Targeted Android Chromium and iPhone WebKit coverage includes the packaged API bridge contract.
